exposure: fasting plasma glucose in early pregnancy
2-hour postprandial glucose by oral glucose tolerance test
0-hour plasma glucose by oral glucose tolerance test
cohort: The study included 2621 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus at a tertiary hospital in western China in 2019.
finding: Elevated prepregnancy body mass index, fasting plasma glucose in early pregnancy, 1-hour and 2-hour postprandial glucose during OGTT, and a history of GDM independently influenced insulin utilization, while elevated 0-hour plasma glucose was an independent factor for unsatisfactory glycemic control, both of which negatively impacted maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Insulin usage (A2 group) was associated with higher rates of cesarean section, whereas unsatisfactory glycemic control was associated with lower rates of cesarean section.
